title: Release Train - Weekly Prep / Go-No-Go Notes
content:
Meeting: Release Train Weekly - Go/No-Go prep
Date: 2026-03-04 (notes / prep doc)
Owner: Samir Patel (release-engineering)
Attendees (expected): Jamie Chen, Priya Kapoor, Olivia Martin, Evan Ramirez, Luke Wu (SRE), Maya Singh (Product)

Objective: quick sync to confirm launch-readiness for the 2.3 infra + serving runtime rollout window next week. Surface blockers, confirm owners and smoke test plan so we can sign off on canary on Monday.

Agenda (15-20m)
- Quick status: infra, runtime, model bundles (2-3m each)
- Go/No-Go checklist review (5m)
- Risks & mitigations (3m)
- Rollout + canary plan + monitoring dashboards (3m)
- Action items & owners (2m)

Go / No-Go Checklist (quick pass)
1) Infra: k8s cluster autoscaler config validated + node pool sizing tested — OWNER: Priya Kapoor — STATUS: in_progress (need final load test metrics)
   - TODO: Priya to attach final cluster-sizing numbers from perf run (due 2026-03-05)
2) Serving runtime: release branch built, integration tests green on staging — OWNER: Jamie Chen — STATUS: done (staging pass 2026-03-02)
3) Model bundles: quantized variants uploaded to artifact registry, checksum verified — OWNER: Olivia Martin — STATUS: done
4) Dedicated fallback variants available in case of latency regressions — OWNER: Samir Patel — STATUS: in_progress (need final routing policy)
   - ACTION: finalize routing policy doc and add to playbook (Samir, due 2026-03-05)
5) Canary plan: traffic split & auto-escalation rules set in console — OWNER: Luke Wu (SRE) — STATUS: pending verification
   - Verify canary rollback automation works (smoke tests trigger rollback)
6) Observability: dashboards, alert thresholds, and runbooks updated — OWNER: Evan Ramirez — STATUS: in_review
   - Linked dashboards: "Per-route latency", "Token cost by route", "Error budget burn"
7) Security/compliance: KMS keys validated for private deployments (if applicable) — OWNER: Maya Singh — STATUS: done
8) Customer comms: release notes + scheduled maintenance window drafted — OWNER: Priya Kapoor — STATUS: draft

Blockers / Open Questions
- Autoscaler behavior under burst traffic: last perf run showed pod churn at 95th pctl requests/sec. Need PoC of smoothing policy (Priya investigating).
- Routing policy: need confirmation on priority between latency-first vs cost-first for enterprise tier during capacity constraints. Who signs final tradeoff? (Product + SRE)
- Runbook gaps: rollback steps for model bundle mismatch are missing exact artifact rollback commands. Add short snippet to playbook.

Risk matrix (high-level)
- Latency regression risk (medium-high): mitigation = canary with tight SLO checks + automatic rollback after 3 consecutive SLO violations (5m window). OWNER: Luke Wu
- Cost spike (medium): mitigation = circuit-breaker to divert traffic to cheaper quantized variant + immediate paging to infra. OWNER: Samir Patel
- Deployment failure causing partial outage (low-medium): mitigation = staged rollout + manual holdpoint at 25% traffic + on-call pager. OWNER: Jamie Chen

Rollout + Canary Plan (outline)
- Day 0 (Mon): deploy to staging -> run smoke suite -> if green, deploy canary to 1% production traffic (3h observation)
- Day 1 (Tue): escalate to 10% if SLOs stable -> 1h observation -> 25% holdpoint (manual approval)
- Day 2 (Wed): ramp to 50% -> then 100% if all checks pass
- Automated gates: per-route latency and error-rate alerts with 5m evaluation window. Failure -> automatic rollback to previous model/serving image
- Communication: slack channel #release-train + automatic notes to release-subscribers list

Production Smoke Test Checklist (post-canary deploy)
- Basic health endpoints (liveness/readiness) — verify 200s from all pods
- Per-route sample generation sanity checks (short prompts) — verify output length and structural correctness
- KV/prefix cache hit rate sanity check — compare against staging baseline
- Token throughput and median latency under synthetic low load (5-10 RPS)
- End-to-end request trace from SDK -> infra -> model bucket -> response (sample trace id)
- Billing/cost metrics: per-token cost vs baseline (spot-check)

Rollback plan (short)
- If canary fails SLO gate: trigger automated rollback job that re-deploys prior image + revert routing policy. Confirm db-less operation. Notify #oncall and #release-train.
- Post-rollback: capture diagnostics tarball (logs + traces) and create follow-up Jira (REL-rollback-<timestamp>)

Action Items (explicit)
- Priya: attach final cluster sizing + smoothing policy proposal (due 2026-03-05)
- Jamie: validate canary rollback automation with a simulated SLO failure (due 2026-03-06)
- Olivia: confirm artifact registry immutability flags and provide quick rollback command snippet for playbook (due 2026-03-05)
- Samir: finalize routing policy doc and add to Release Playbook v2 (due 2026-03-05)
- Evan: publish final dashboards + alert runbooks link in Confluence and tag #oncall (due 2026-03-05)
- Luke: verify canary traffic split automation and practice manual holdpoint for 25% (due 2026-03-06)

Notes to self / meeting prep reminders
- Print short 1-pager with key SLO numbers for the ship-room (median latency, 95p latency, error rate thresholds).
- Bring the exact commands for rolling back model bundles and snapshot the artifact registry UI for the meeting.
- Confirm that the legal/compliance tag for this rollout is included in maintenance window email (Maya to confirm).

Follow-ups after meeting (post-approval steps)
- Create a single-line release announcement + link to release notes; schedule for maintenance window email. OWNER: Priya
- Kick off canary at 09:00 PT Monday once staging green and final owners confirm (Samir to trigger)
- Add "lessons learned" item to retro board if rollback happens (automated ticket template)

Quick status summary for the meeting start (one-liners to read out)
- Infra: cluster sizing in final validation (Priya)
- Runtime: staging green (Jamie)
- Models: artifacts uploaded & checksums verified (Olivia)
- Monitoring: dashboards in review (Evan)
- Canary automation: pending final SRE verification (Luke)

Unresolved sign-offs needed
- Product sign-off on routing policy (Maya / Product)
- Security confirm KMS audit log visibility (Security)

Seed notes (scratch)
- Consider adding a short TTL to canary cookies to prevent sticky sessions during rollouts.
- If cost-first routing is chosen, ensure billing alerts override auto-escalation (note for finance)

-- end of prep notes --

(Informal / scratchpad: keep updating. This doc will be attached to the weekly meeting invite and referenced in the release playbook)
